target: [pic=4]Setiap tahun pada waktu seperti ini, kedua koyote berkunjung dan memangkas wolku.

target: [pic=2]Membuatku lebih sejuk selama musim ini, sekaligus memberi bahan untuk sesama insan kreatif!

source: [pic=4]But since the bridge has been out, They haven’t had the opportunity to come by.
target: [pic=4]Tapi sejak jembatannya rusak, mereka belum sempat mampir.

source: [pic=4]It’s been a drag for sure, but it is what it is.
[pic=2]I spend a lot of time in the shade when I can.
Why not go up the mountain?
[pic=4]Ok lil’ guy, between you and me…
target: [pic=4]Oke, Kawan Kecil, ini antara kita saja…

source: [pic=2]there’s a couple critters up there that I used to live with.
target: [pic=2]ada dua penghuni di atas sana yang dulu tinggal serumah denganku.

source: [pic=2]Cool critters, but not exactly… Chill, ya feel me?
target: [pic=2]Mereka asyik, tapi tidak bisa dibilang… adem, paham?

source: [pic=2]Besides… it’s not THAT hot…
Roommates?
[pic=2]Yeah man, you’re bound to meet them if you stick around!
target: [pic=2]Iya, Kawan, pasti bertemu mereka kalau kamu tetap di sini!

source: [pic=2]One’s a fox and one’s a bear.
[pic=3]Quite the pair if you ask me!
[pic=2]Have you ever had roommates, Rascal?
Yes I have!
[pic=4]Then you know how it goes man.
[pic=4]Some folks are great as friends, but absolutely terrible roommates.
target: [pic=4]Ada yang hebat sebagai teman, tapi payah sekali sebagai teman serumah.

source: [pic=3]Great folks, really.
[pic=4]Just terrible roommates.
I have not.
[pic=2]Ah, livin’ that solo life.
[pic=2]Take it from me, man. It’s the dream.
[pic=1]Red! Hey I got a favor to ask.
[pic=2]I’ve heard of a rope-oriented bondage that I’d like to try out!
target: [pic=2]Kudengar ada permainan ikatan dengan tali yang ingin kucoba!

source: [pic=3]Problem is I can’t seem to find any ropes that are my size, but comfortable enough.
target: [pic=3]Masalahnya, aku belum menemukan tali yang sesuai ukuranku sekaligus cukup nyaman.

source: [pic=1]Think you can keep an eye out for me?
[pic=1]Any luck on that rope? I’d imagine something like a yarn… or twine…
target: [pic=1]Sudah menemukan talinya? Aku membayangkan sesuatu seperti benang wol… atau benang pilin…

source: [pic=3]I tried fishing-wire, that wasn’t a great idea…
target: [pic=3]Aku mencoba senar pancing, ternyata bukan ide bagus…

source: [pic=1]Any word on that rope?
[pic=1]Red! How’s the rope-finding going?
[pic=1]Umm… Hey Red, do you mind?
Top or bottom?
[pic=4]Oh heh, I’m a bottom through and through!
[pic=1]I can take charge, for sure. But I’m most comfortable when I’m receiving!
target: [pic=1]Aku bisa memegang kendali, tentu. Tapi paling nyaman kalau menerima!

source: What do you study?
[pic=4]You’re familiar with the rumors yes?
[pic=2]“This place is full of critters banging 24/7” etcetera etcetera.
target: [pic=2]“Tempat ini penuh orang yang bercinta 24/7”, dan sebagainya.

source: [pic=5]Well the rumors aren’t entirely false, they are, however, mistimed.
target: [pic=5]Yah, desas-desus itu tidak sepenuhnya salah, hanya salah waktu.

source: [pic=4]Rumors carry some weight, you see. To some extent, they are often built on truth.
target: [pic=4]Desas-desus itu ada bobotnya. Sering kali ada kebenaran yang mendasarinya.

source: [pic=2]This rumor is no different.
[pic=5]Though as you’ve seen around you, that doesn’t particularly seem to be the case now.
target: [pic=5]Meski seperti yang Anda lihat, sekarang tampaknya tidak begitu.

source: [pic=5]And I’ve lived here many years, and I can assure you, it’s quite the normal town.
target: [pic=5]Saya sudah bertahun-tahun tinggal di sini, dan saya pastikan kota ini cukup biasa saja.

source: [pic=4]So the question is now, When?
[pic=2]That’s what I’ve been studying.
[pic=4]The history of these parts goes quite deep.
History?
[pic=5]You may have spotted a few runes/glyphs here ‘n there yes?
target: [pic=5]Mungkin Anda sudah melihat beberapa rune/glif di sana-sini, bukan?

source: [pic=4]Some of the critters have taken a few as souvenirs, I’ve got quite a few myself.
target: [pic=4]Beberapa penghuni mengambilnya sebagai kenang-kenangan. Saya sendiri juga punya cukup banyak.

source: [pic=2]To study, of course.
[pic=4]To the West of here is an even larger collection of ancient history.
target: [pic=4]Di sebelah barat sini ada kumpulan peninggalan sejarah kuno yang lebih besar lagi.

source: [pic=5]The ruins have scriptures, symbols, and signs of architecture from long before our time.
target: [pic=5]Reruntuhan itu memiliki tulisan suci, lambang, dan jejak arsitektur dari masa jauh sebelum kita.

source: [pic=5]A lot remains unclear about the history here…
target: [pic=5]Banyak hal tentang sejarah di sini yang masih belum jelas…

source: [pic=2]But the fact remains that this place was something special.
target: [pic=2]Tapi yang pasti, tempat ini dahulu istimewa.

source: Scriptures?
[pic=5]I’ve done a fair share of transcribing the writings, as best as I can at least.
target: [pic=5]Sudah cukup banyak tulisannya saya salin, setidaknya sebaik kemampuan saya.

source: [pic=5]It appears their language had something more to it than simply speech…
target: [pic=5]Tampaknya bahasa mereka punya sesuatu yang lebih dari sekadar tuturan…

source: [pic=2]I believe the scriptures are not complete on their own… but simply, an aid.
target: [pic=2]Saya yakin tulisan suci itu tidak lengkap dengan sendirinya, melainkan sekadar alat bantu.

source: [pic=4]So without the missing pieces, what we end up having is a small fraction of the story.
target: [pic=4]Jadi tanpa bagian yang hilang, kita cuma mendapat sebagian kecil kisahnya.

source: [pic=5]Unfortunately, the few things I have gathered basically confirm the rumors.
target: [pic=5]Sayangnya, beberapa hal yang saya temukan pada dasarnya membenarkan desas-desus itu.

source: [pic=2]Critters of all kinds gathered here to share delight in pleasures of the flesh.
target: [pic=2]Berbagai jenis makhluk berkumpul di sini untuk berbagi kenikmatan ragawi.

source: [pic=5]But I couldn’t tell you why.
[pic=2]Was it just pleasure?
[pic=2]Was it purely coincidental?
[pic=2]Is there something more we aren’t seeing?
target: [pic=2]Apa ada sesuatu yang belum kita lihat?

source: [pic=5]There was almost a system involved. Intent.
[pic=4]So I believe it was some method of paying tribute… or worship…
target: [pic=4]Jadi saya yakin itu semacam cara memberi penghormatan… atau pemujaan…

source: Glyphs?
[pic=2]No doubt you’ve seen a few reoccurring glyphs around.
target: [pic=2]Pasti Anda sudah melihat beberapa glif yang berulang di sekitar sini.

source: [pic=4]These, I’ve gathered, are representations of areas.
target: [pic=4]Dari yang saya pelajari, glif itu melambangkan wilayah.

source: [pic=4]The nearby surrounding biomes of the town no doubt.
target: [pic=4]Tentu saja, bioma-bioma di sekitar kota ini.

source: [pic=5]But what is their significance? What is the purpose?
[pic=2]I couldn’t tell you.
[pic=5]Perhaps it was merely an early indication of cartography?
[pic=2]The problem is we don’t know how primitive, or even advanced, this society was.
target: [pic=2]Masalahnya, kita tidak tahu seprimitif atau bahkan semaju apa masyarakat itu.

source: [pic=4]Investigating the surrounding areas has proved fruitless in this matter.
target: [pic=4]Penyelidikan wilayah sekitarnya belum membuahkan hasil soal ini.

source: Oldest critters here?
[pic=2]Barnaby and I - Er Bucky as you know him, are the eldest in town.
target: [pic=2]Barnaby dan saya, er, Bucky seperti yang Anda kenal, adalah yang tertua di kota.

source: [pic=5]But when we arrived, the inhabitants were clueless of the history here.
target: [pic=5]Tapi saat kami datang, penduduknya tidak tahu apa-apa soal sejarah di sini.

source: [pic=5]In fact, “The Forest of Love” wasn’t even the name of this area.
target: [pic=5]Bahkan, dahulu nama daerah ini bukan “Hutan Cinta”.

source: [pic=4]The rumors formed, and the name was derived from the rumors.
target: [pic=4]Desas-desusnya muncul, lalu nama itu berasal dari desas-desus tersebut.

source: [pic=4]Fascinating isn’t it?
[pic=5]From what I’ve gathered, the original name of the area is in a tongue long forgotten.
target: [pic=5]Dari yang saya temukan, nama asli daerah ini berasal dari bahasa yang sudah lama terlupakan.

source: [pic=2]I believe the mysteries of this area go much beyond generations.
target: [pic=2]Saya yakin misteri daerah ini jauh melampaui beberapa generasi.

source: [pic=5]It takes a long time for a culture to establish, die out, and be nearly forgotten.
target: [pic=5]Butuh waktu lama bagi suatu budaya untuk terbentuk, punah, lalu nyaris dilupakan.

source: [pic=4]We’re talking ages. Centuries. Perhaps millenia!
target: [pic=4]Kita bicara zaman demi zaman. Berabad-abad. Mungkin ribuan tahun!

source: [pic=4]It’s truly fascinating!
Bucky?
[pic=5]Good ole Barnaby…
[pic=2]Him and I were mates some time ago.
[pic=5]We have our differences, and Barnaby wasn’t particularly too keen on a lot of mine…
target: [pic=5]Kami punya perbedaan, dan Barnaby kurang menyukai banyak sifat saya…

source: [pic=4]See, I’m quite dedicated to my studies.
target: [pic=4]Begini, saya sangat mengabdikan diri pada penelitian.

source: [pic=5]Perhaps, too dedicated…
[pic=2]Barnaby is a fine fellow, but he was never one to handle social conflicts too well.
target: [pic=2]Barnaby orang baik, tapi dia tidak pernah terlalu pandai menghadapi konflik dengan orang lain.

source: [pic=5]And I’m not exactly one to talk about my own needs or wants too often…

source: [pic=4]Haha, critters are such complex creatures…
target: [pic=4]Haha, makhluk seperti kita ini rumit sekali…

source: [pic=4]heh…

source: [pic=3]Though, a lot of that might be due to some insecurities I have with my uh, body parts…
target: [pic=3]Tapi mungkin banyak disebabkan rasa kurang percaya diriku soal, eh, bagian tubuhku…

source: You look great!
[pic=3]No, that’s not what I mean.

target: [pic=3]Banyak yang melihat paruh dan cakar tajam, lalu tidak mau itu mendekati bagian sensitif mereka…

source: [pic=4]But I’m very gentle and have a lot of finesse!
target: [pic=4]Tapi aku sangat lembut dan sangat terampil!

source: Top or bottom?

source: [pic=1]I also hope they’d visit me every once in a while! Bahawhaw!
target: [pic=1]Aku juga berharap mereka sesekali mengunjungiku! Bahawhaw!

target: Apa yang kamu suka lakukan untuk bersantai?

target: [pic=2]Kurasa aku bisa dua-duanya, tapi bagaimanapun perannya aku cenderung submisif.

source: [pic=1]Though if you’d ask my wife, she’d say I’m a bottom, for sure, hah!
target: [pic=1]Tapi kalau tanya istriku, dia pasti bilang aku bottom, hah!

source: [pic=2]There we go!
[pic=2]This is a huge batch!
[pic=7]Definitely enough for my little garden here, thank you so much dear!
target: [pic=7]Ini pasti cukup untuk kebun kecilku, terima kasih banyak, Sayang!

target: [pic=2]Pokoknya, ada bagian lain dari perayaan itu yang tidak kuikuti karena aku menyiapkan Pemberkatan yang sesungguhnya.

source: I see! Ok, I will talk to him.
target: Begitu! Oke, aku akan bicara dengannya.

source: [pic=2]Thanks for asking about this though! I’m happy to teach folks about this since it’s a time that’s very close to my heart!
target: [pic=2]Tapi terima kasih sudah bertanya! Aku senang menceritakannya karena masa itu begitu dekat di hatiku!

source: Thank you for telling me!
[pic=1]Anytime dear!
[pic=5]Critters had no choice but to band together. They would exchange and share provisions, huddle for warmth, and share in eachother’s company.
target: [pic=5]Para penghuni tidak punya pilihan selain bersatu. Mereka bertukar dan berbagi perbekalan, berhimpitan menghangatkan diri, dan saling menemani.

source: [pic=8]But they knew it wouldn’t last, they knew they needed help.
target: [pic=8]Tapi mereka tahu itu tidak akan bertahan, mereka tahu butuh bantuan.

source: [pic=5]So each night, when the weather was the most still, the critters would ring their bells for hope that anyone would hear it.
target: [pic=5]Jadi setiap malam, saat cuaca paling tenang, para penghuni membunyikan lonceng dengan harapan ada yang mendengar.

source: [pic=5]Day after day, new critters would show up, share in the warmth and comfort others could provide, and night after night, they would ring their bells.
target: [pic=5]Hari demi hari, penghuni baru berdatangan, berbagi kehangatan dan kenyamanan yang bisa diberikan yang lain, dan malam demi malam, mereka membunyikan lonceng.

source: [pic=5]Weeks went by. Until finally, on the 18th night, a heavy sound rung out from the skies.
target: [pic=5]Minggu demi minggu berlalu. Hingga akhirnya, pada malam ke-18, bunyi berat bergema dari langit.

source: [pic=4]The familiar sound of a bell, but this one was much larger… It grew louder and louder. It was coming closer!
target: [pic=4]Bunyi lonceng yang mereka kenal, tapi yang ini jauh lebih besar… Bunyinya makin keras. Makin dekat!

source: [pic=10]On the 19th night, a great falcon was spotted in the distance.
target: [pic=10]Pada malam ke-19, seekor falkon besar terlihat di kejauhan.

source: [pic=10]The bird carried a tremendous bell, ringing out far into the night.
target: [pic=10]Burung itu membawa lonceng raksasa, bunyinya menggema jauh menembus malam.

source: [pic=1]The critters calls were heard, they were answered!
[pic=7]The Falcon circled overhead, ringing out their giant bell. And the critters joined in with their own chorus of bells!
target: [pic=7]Falkon itu berputar di atas, membunyikan lonceng raksasanya. Dan para penghuni ikut serta dengan paduan bunyi lonceng mereka!

source: [pic=4]Within hours, a rescue team came barreling after the falcon, providing food and water to all.
target: [pic=4]Dalam beberapa jam, tim penyelamat menyusul falkon itu dengan cepat, menyediakan makanan dan air bagi semua.

source: [pic=3]Thus, The Blessing of the Bells became a widespread story. A necessity for winter survival back in the day.
target: [pic=3]Begitulah Berkah Lonceng menjadi kisah yang tersebar luas. Dulu itu kebutuhan untuk bertahan hidup di musim dingin.

source: What’s that?
[pic=1]I go flying around with a BIG OLE BELL ringing across the lands!
target: [pic=1]Aku terbang berkeliling membawa LONCENG BESAR, membunyikannya ke seluruh penjuru!

source: [pic=4]Critters down below will join me ringing out their own bells as I pass by. It’s a wonderful time!
target: [pic=4]Penghuni di bawah ikut membunyikan lonceng mereka saat aku lewat. Saat yang indah!

source: That sounds beautiful.
[pic=1]It really is! It’s a magical time, and I’m super grateful I can be a part of it!
target: [pic=1]Memang! Saat yang ajaib, dan aku bersyukur sekali bisa menjadi bagiannya!

source: [pic=3]Did Scarlett tell you why this is a holiday at all? Where it all started?
target: [pic=3]Scarlett sudah cerita kenapa ini menjadi hari raya? Dari mana asalnya?

source: She said I should hear it from you.
[pic=4]Ah! I see!
[pic=3]Well The Blessing of the Bells has become much more superficial these days.
target: [pic=3]Yah, belakangan Berkah Lonceng lebih berfokus pada hal-hal luarnya.

source: [pic=3]Gift giving, partying, decorations, friends and family, y’know how it goes…
target: [pic=3]Memberi hadiah, berpesta, dekorasi, teman dan keluarga, kamu tahu sendiri…

source: [pic=8]But it actually started in much darker times…
target: [pic=8]Tapi sebenarnya bermula di masa yang jauh lebih kelam…

source: [pic=5]Long ago, the Winters were very harsh, and times were much tougher. Provisions were harder to come by, and larger communities like ours were quite scarce.
target: [pic=5]Dahulu kala, Musim Dingin sangat keras, dan kehidupan jauh lebih sulit. Perbekalan lebih susah didapat, dan komunitas besar seperti kita cukup langka.

source: [pic=8]Snowy seasons were quite dangerous. If a family didn’t prepare, there were dire consequences…
target: [pic=8]Musim bersalju cukup berbahaya. Kalau sebuah keluarga tidak bersiap, akibatnya sangat buruk…

source: [pic=8]One terrible Winter, the winds blew harder than ever, the snow was relentless, the temperatures were unbearable.
target: [pic=8]Pada suatu Musim Dingin yang mengerikan, angin bertiup lebih kencang dari sebelumnya, salju tak kunjung berhenti, suhunya tak tertahankan.

source: [pic=1]It’s my favorite holiday!
[pic=4]Have you celebrated it before?
I have not.
[pic=1]Oh it’s a wonderful time! Lots of the critters here get into the spirit of things.
target: [pic=1]Oh, itu saat yang indah! Banyak penghuni di sini ikut bersemangat.

source: [pic=2]I hope you’ll join us for the next one!

I’d like to!
Can you tell me more about it?
target:
Aku mau!
Bisa ceritakan lebih banyak?

source: [pic=1]Of course!
[pic=2]It’s a month long celebration, where critters bundle up, decorate their surroundings, share gifts and meals!
target: [pic=2]Perayaannya sebulan penuh, para penghuni mengenakan pakaian hangat, menghias sekitar, berbagi hadiah dan makanan!

source: [pic=4]We close out each night of celebration with a ringing of a bell!
target: [pic=4]Kami menutup setiap malam perayaan dengan bunyi lonceng!

source: [pic=1]Then do the whole thing over the next day!
That sounds fun!
[pic=4]It is! And that’s not even the best part!
target: [pic=4]Memang! Dan itu bahkan belum bagian terbaiknya!

source: [pic=6]The very last day, yours truly finishes the entire celebration with "The Blessing!"
target: [pic=6]Pada hari terakhir, aku sendiri menutup seluruh perayaan dengan “Pemberkatan!”

I’ve heard you know a thing or two
about The Blessing of the Bells?

[pic=4]Salutations Rascal!
[pic=2]What do I owe the pleasure?

I was wondering if you could
tell me about The Blessing of the Bells
target:
Aku ingin tahu apa kamu bisa
bercerita tentang Berkah Lonceng

source: [pic=5]Oh? Isn’t it a little early to be thinking of that?
target: [pic=5]Oh? Bukankah agak terlalu awal untuk memikirkannya?

source: [pic=2]It’s the middle of Summer after all…
[pic=4]Er wait, have you celebrated The Blessing before?

source:
I’ve just learned about it.

source: [pic=2]Ah yes, you’ve come to the right gator!
target: [pic=2]Ah ya, Anda menemui aligator yang tepat!

source: [pic=4]Knowing Penny, she’s likely told you the cultural and historical significance already?
target: [pic=4]Mengenal Penny, kemungkinan dia sudah menceritakan makna budaya dan sejarahnya?

source: Yep!
[pic=4]Great!
[pic=2]I’m assuming she told you to come to me to hear about The Saint?
target: [pic=2]Saya berasumsi dia menyuruh Anda menemui saya untuk mendengar tentang Sang Suci?

source: She mentioned that.
[pic=5]Haha, I bet she wasn’t too keen on telling you that part…
target: [pic=5]Haha, pasti dia tidak terlalu ingin menceritakan bagian itu…

source: It seemed a little forced…
[pic=2]Indeed… See cultural holidays will vastly change over generations.
target: [pic=2]Memang… Begini, hari raya budaya berubah drastis dari generasi ke generasi.

source: [pic=5]It can be hard to tell what stemmed from legitimacy, and what was added for fun.
target: [pic=5]Kadang sulit membedakan mana yang berasal dari kenyataan, dan mana yang ditambahkan untuk bersenang-senang.

source: [pic=2]To Penny’s credit, I can’t say I’ve seen records of "The Saint" being involved with The Blessing…
target: [pic=2]Harus saya akui Penny ada benarnya, saya belum pernah melihat catatan bahwa “Sang Suci” terlibat dalam Berkah…

source: [pic=4]But as a child, this aspect was a favorite of mine for the festivities. I’m definitely guilty of perpetuating this nonsense, but it’s so fun!
target: [pic=4]Tetapi sewaktu kecil, bagian ini favorit saya dalam perayaan. Saya memang ikut melestarikan omong kosong ini, tetapi seru sekali!

source: So what is it?
[pic=4]Right - so, you’re generally familiar with the origins of The Blessing of the Bells?
target: [pic=4]Baiklah, jadi Anda sudah cukup tahu asal-usul Berkah Lonceng?

source: Yep!
[pic=2]Well it’s been said that there was a mysterious critter going around providing small boons and gifts to the young.
target: [pic=2]Konon ada sosok misterius yang berkeliling memberi bantuan kecil dan hadiah kepada yang muda.

source: [pic=5]Likely to keep their mind off of such perilous times.
target: [pic=5]Mungkin untuk mengalihkan pikiran mereka dari masa yang begitu berbahaya.

source: [pic=4]Again, no official records of that happening - But the myth became tradition!
target: [pic=4]Sekali lagi, tidak ada catatan resmi tentang itu, tetapi mitosnya menjadi tradisi!

source: [pic=2]It’s customary to give each other gifts during this holiday, but it’s also customary to give some gifts in total anonymity, thus continuing on the spirit of "The Saint".
target: [pic=2]Sudah menjadi kebiasaan saling memberi hadiah saat hari raya ini, tetapi juga memberi sebagian hadiah tanpa mengungkap identitas sama sekali, sehingga semangat “Sang Suci” terus hidup.

source: Oooh that sounds fun!
[pic=8]It’s a blast!
[pic=4]And there’s no secret that I try to play that role during our celebrations…
target: [pic=4]Dan bukan rahasia bahwa saya mencoba memainkan peran itu saat perayaan kami…

source: [pic=3]Believe me, it’s QUITE TRICKY for a fella like me to provide gifts without being noticed…
target: [pic=3]Percayalah, CUKUP SULIT bagi sosok seperti saya untuk memberi hadiah tanpa ketahuan…

source: Haha, I’d imagine!
[pic=5]But the most interesting part Rascal…
[pic=5]Even I receive some of these anonymous gifts… Like truly anonymous.
target: [pic=5]Bahkan saya pun menerima sebagian hadiah anonim ini… Benar-benar anonim.

source: [pic=4]See, it’s always easy to tell when a critter here is "trying" to be secretive.
target: [pic=4]Begini, selalu mudah tahu saat penghuni di sini “mencoba” berahasia.

source: [pic=5]But I’ll occasionally get a truly mysterious gift, and try as I might, no one seems to know where it comes from.
target: [pic=5]Tetapi sesekali saya mendapat hadiah yang benar-benar misterius, dan sekeras apa pun saya mencoba, sepertinya tidak ada yang tahu asalnya.

source: [pic=4]All the critters know I’m supposed to be "The Saint" - so they often think I’m messing with them.
target: [pic=4]Semua penghuni tahu seharusnya sayalah “Sang Suci”, jadi mereka sering mengira saya sedang mengerjai mereka.

source: [pic=5]But I swear to you, I’ve no idea who keeps gifting me things during the festivities.
target: [pic=5]Tetapi saya bersumpah kepada Anda, saya tidak tahu siapa yang terus memberi saya hadiah selama perayaan.

source: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.
target: [pic=2]Jelas pasti penghuni di sini, dan sebenarnya saya senang melihat semangat Sang Suci tetap hidup.

source: That sounds mysterious indeed!
[pic=4]Anyways, will you be joining us for this year’s Blessing?
target: [pic=4]Pokoknya, Anda akan ikut Berkah tahun ini?

source: I hope so! It sounds amazing!
[pic=2]It really is a special time here for us.
target: [pic=2]Ini sungguh masa yang istimewa bagi kami di sini.

source: [pic=4]I know I don’t speak for myself when I say we’d love to have you!
target: [pic=4]Saya tahu bukan hanya saya yang merasa kami akan senang sekali menyambut Anda!

target: Selamat, para wanita, kalian sudah merusak suasana.

source: You’ve been oddly quiet Rascal. <pause>Did I break you?
target: Kamu diam sekali, Rascal. <pause>Apa kamu sampai rusak?

source: Nah, just enjoying this victory.
Victory?
Yeah, taking a wolf. <pause>Piece of cake!
Really? <pause>Then why didn’t you take the knot?
target: Sungguh? <pause>Lalu kenapa kamu tidak menampung simpul genitalnya?

source: I don’t tie on the first date! <pause>I’m classy! Ya gotta at least buy me dinner first…
target: Aku tidak mau terikat di kencan pertama! <pause>Aku punya kelas! Setidaknya traktir aku makan malam dulu…

source: <slow>Riiight.</slow> <pause>But you’ll take a huge load in your ass, and squirt all over my stomach. <pause>Reaaally classy!
target: <slow>Begituuu.</slow> <pause>Tapi kamu mau menerima peju berlimpah di pantatmu, dan muncrat ke seluruh perutku. <pause>Berkelas sekaliii!

source: Now who’s gonna clean that up?
<size=18>Me!</size>
[pic=2]Yeah, I should’ve listened to you sooner…
[pic=7]Nonsense, time is important. <pause>You weren’t ready then, and now you are.
target: [pic=7]Ah, waktu itu penting. <pause>Dulu kamu belum siap, sekarang sudah.

source: [pic=7]Yeah… <pause>Well thanks again.
[pic=1]Hah, don’t thank me yet! <pause>I’m gonna bury you in new friends!
target: [pic=1]Hah, jangan berterima kasih dulu! <pause>Akan kubanjiri kamu dengan teman-teman baru!

source: [pic=5]Gah~! <pause>Alright get out of here.
[pic=2]’Till next time!
[pic=4]Well damn! That was hot as hell!
[pic=2]I’ll say! <pause>I absolutely adore watchin’ boys goin’ at it.
target: [pic=2]Betul sekali! <pause>Aku suka sekali melihat para pria bercinta.

source: [pic=7]Yeah yeah, you all got what you wanted. <pause>Now let me rest!
target: [pic=7]Iya iya, kalian sudah dapat yang kalian mau. <pause>Sekarang biarkan aku istirahat!

source:
Fen we really appreciate
you helping out.

But don’t think you’re
gettin’ off that easily!
target:
Tapi jangan kira kamu bisa
lepas begitu saja!

source: [pic=5]Eh?
[pic=6]That’s right, We’ll be back! <pause>And I wanna see what that tongue can do besides being grumpy.
target: [pic=6]Betul, kami akan kembali! <pause>Dan aku ingin tahu kemampuan lidahmu selain menggerutu.

source: [pic=5]Hah, is that so? Well I guess I’ll be seeing you then.
target: [pic=5]Hah, begitu? Yah, kalau begitu sampai nanti.

source: Absolutely!
[pic=2]Oh uh… <pause>What are you guys going to do with my uh… stuff.
target: [pic=2]Oh, eh… <pause>Kalian mau melakukan apa dengan, eh… barangku itu.

source: [pic=3]<slow>Uhhh...</slow> Long story short, <pause>it’s for an orgy!
[pic=7]Sorry, I’d just invite you! <pause>But my people are uh… <pause>kinda terrified of you…
target: [pic=7]Maaf, sebenarnya ingin kuundang kamu! <pause>Tapi kaumku agak… <pause>takut sekali kepadamu…

source: [pic=7]Hah, smart critters.
[pic=7]And don’t feel bad. <pause>I wouldn’t go anyways.
target: [pic=7]Dan jangan merasa bersalah. <pause>Aku juga tidak akan ikut.

source: [pic=2]I may be trying to open up, but uh… <pause>Just a couple critters at a time…
target: [pic=2]Aku mungkin sedang berusaha membuka diri, tapi, eh… <pause>Cukup beberapa penghuni saja sekaligus…

source: [pic=2]For sure! One step at a time!
[pic=2]It was great to see you again.
[pic=8]I’ve been so busy the past lil while.
[pic=7]No worries, give my regards to Peter.
[pic=2]Of course! <pause>He’s been talking about wanting to get the gang together again for some scavenging!
target: [pic=2]Tentu! <pause>Dia bilang ingin mengumpulkan geng kita lagi untuk mencari barang!

source: [pic=6]Oh? <pause>Well I’m in.
[pic=1]We’ve also been getting the basement back in order…
target: [pic=1]Kami juga sedang membereskan ruang bawah tanah lagi…

source: [pic=5]Is that so? <pause>Need someone to help break it in?
[pic=7]I’ll be in touch!
[pic=2]Scarlett…
[pic=3]Yes?
[pic=2]… Thanks,<pause> really.
[pic=7]No need to thank me! <pause>It was great seeing you enjoy yourself!
target: [pic=7]Tidak perlu berterima kasih! <pause>Aku senang sekali melihatmu bersenang-senang!

source: [pic=2]Quite a breakthrough today!
[pic=2]Oh look at the lil guy! <pause>He’s excited!
*The plant wiggles its roots, and chirps happily, it seems to recognize Scarlett*
target: *Tanaman itu menggoyangkan akarnya dan berkicau riang, sepertinya mengenali Scarlett*

source: [pic=3]How are you dear, did you miss momma?
[pic=2]<bounce>Yes you did, momma missed you too!</bounce>
target: [pic=2]<bounce>Iya, kamu kangen, mama juga kangen kamu!</bounce>

source: [pic=3]Who’s a good plant?
[pic=2]<bounce>You are! Yes you are!</bounce>
[pic=3]Alright alright, get a room you two!
target: [pic=3]Sudah, sudah, cari kamar sana kalian berdua!

source: [pic=7]You know I’d love to!
[pic=3]But alas, I can’t right now.
*The plant's movements slow, it seems to understand. It lets out a slow chur.*
target: *Gerakan tanaman itu melambat, sepertinya mengerti. Dia mengeluarkan dengkuran pelan.*

source: [pic=6]I know, I know.
[pic=7]I’ll be sure to come back real soon, ok?
*The plant wiggles in anticipation again.*
[pic=3]Ok, let’s go.
[pic=7]Looks like my job here is done!
[pic=3]I wanted to thank you guys again for helping Fen out there.
target: [pic=3]Aku ingin berterima kasih lagi karena kalian membantu Fen tadi.

source: [pic=4]Naw, he helped us!
[pic=1]Heh, you helped him more than you know.
target: [pic=1]Heh, bantuan kalian kepadanya lebih besar dari yang kalian kira.

source: [pic=2]Anywho, I’m off!
[pic=1]Thanks for all your help!
We’ll be seeing you!
[pic=2]Take care!
(She seems a lot more friendly now. Maybe a bit too friendly)
target: (Sekarang dia tampak jauh lebih ramah. Mungkin agak terlalu ramah)

source: Uh, yeah you too!
[pic=5]MOOOOOOM!!!!
[pic=1]Grateful! Grateful to fluff!
Throughout the night, mice swap partners, positions, and fluids.
target: Sepanjang malam, para tikus bertukar pasangan, posisi, dan cairan.

source: The mice lose themselves in a tangle of paws and tails.
target: Para tikus larut dalam belitan kaki dan ekor.

source: And of course, they shower their warrior with just as much love and affection.
target: Dan tentu saja, pejuang mereka juga dilimpahi cinta dan kasih sayang yang sama besarnya.

source: As Rascal places the jar near the stump, two elder female mice approach him, their bodies adorned from head to paw with intricate tattoos. They gesture for Rascal to lie down.
target: Saat Rascal menaruh stoples di dekat tunggul, dua tetua tikus perempuan mendekatinya. Tubuh mereka berhias tato rumit dari kepala sampai kaki. Mereka memberi isyarat agar Rascal berbaring.

source: One mouse working on Rascal’s thighs trail off, settling between his legs. They explore his sheath and move down to his balls. The mouse strokes them lovingly for just a moment, before one of the elders scolds them.
target: Salah satu tikus yang menangani paha Rascal bergerak menjauh, lalu menempatkan diri di antara kakinya. Tikus itu menjelajahi selubung kontolnya, lalu turun ke buah zakarnya. Dibelainya dengan penuh kasih sebentar saja sebelum salah satu tetua menegurnya.

source: When he lowers his head, the mice gently place leaves over his eyes. With his vision obscured, Rascal focuses on the sounds around him. The pitter-patter of tiny paws fills the air, growing louder as more mice join in.
target: Saat Rascal menunduk, para tikus meletakkan dedaunan di atas matanya dengan lembut. Karena pandangannya terhalang, Rascal berfokus pada suara di sekelilingnya. Derap kaki mungil memenuhi udara, makin keras saat lebih banyak tikus bergabung.

source: As the leaves are lifted from Rascal's eyes, he looks down and sees intricate swirls and shapes perfectly mirrored across his body. Nearby, a few mice beam with pride at their handiwork.
target: Saat dedaunan diangkat dari mata Rascal, dia melihat ke bawah. Pola pusaran dan bentuk rumit menghiasi tubuhnya dengan simetri sempurna. Di dekatnya, beberapa tikus tersenyum bangga melihat hasil karya mereka.

source: A floral aroma pierces Rascal's nostrils as the mice begin grinding something. One of the elders barks out commands, and the air fills with citrus and a trace of mint.
target: Aroma bunga menusuk hidung Rascal saat para tikus mulai menggiling sesuatu. Salah satu tetua meneriakkan perintah, dan udara dipenuhi aroma jeruk dengan sedikit mint.

source: “Thank you!” Rascal says, while one of the mice leads him toward the campfire. More mice gather around, watching intently as the elders take turns tossing various items into the fire.
target: “Terima kasih!” kata Rascal, sementara salah satu tikus menuntunnya ke api unggun. Makin banyak tikus berkumpul, memperhatikan dengan saksama saat para tetua bergantian melemparkan berbagai benda ke dalam api.

source: Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.
target: Kaki-kaki mungil bergerak teratur di atas tubuh Rascal, melukis sapuan tegas dan pusaran rumit. Para tikus bekerja dengan selaras sempurna.

source: Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.
target: Di seberang tanah lapang, tunggul tempat Mabel berada bercahaya dengan irama tetap. Setiap denyut memancarkan cahaya cemerlang. Pada setiap semburan warna, nyala api unggun merespons serempak.

source: The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.
target: Nyanyian para tetua tikus makin lantang! Lidah api dan kilatan merah muda menyembur dari api unggun! Saat itu terjadi, para tikus berpasangan dan mulai berciuman.

source: The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.
target: Nyala api mereda saat ritual berakhir. Para tikus yang kelelahan dan masih menetes memberi isyarat agar Rascal mengikuti mereka ke anak sungai di dekat situ.

source: Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.
target: Dua tikus memanjat Rascal dan mulai menjelajahi moncongnya. “Ikuti saja arahan mereka,” pikir Rascal saat mereka mengecup sekitar bibirnya. Dia membelai para tikus dengan lembut dan mendekatkan mereka.

source: They wash up and return to the campfire...
target: Mereka membersihkan diri lalu kembali ke api unggun...

source: The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...
target: Ketiganya bergantian berciuman mesra dan saling menjelajahi tubuh. Rascal makin berani memakai lidah, dan para tikus membalas dengan semangat yang sama. Lalu, pepohonan bersinar merah cemerlang. Dan ritual pun dimulai...

target: [pic=1]Menurutmu dia keberatan kalau aku menonton dia mencoba mainannya?

source: [pic=3]So the Bear liked my eggplant idea?
[pic=3]That’s great to hear!
[pic=2]I’ll have to share more of my advice with her…
target: [pic=2]Aku harus membagi lebih banyak saranku kepadanya…

source: [pic=3]Hm… y’know… she’s the only one I’m not… intimately familiar with…
target: [pic=3]Hm… dia satu-satunya yang belum… kukenal secara intim…

source: [pic=1]We swung with the couple a few times~! Let me tell ya, that bear had stamina!
target: [pic=1]Kami beberapa kali bertukar pasangan dengan mereka~! Harus kubilang, beruang itu luar biasa staminanya!

source: [pic=2]Once you’ve seen a bear carry a beaver, you’ve seen it all, trust me!
target: [pic=2]Setelah melihat beruang menggendong berang-berang pembuat bendungan, kamu sudah melihat segalanya, percayalah!

source: [pic=3]Nothin’ quite like being handled by a bear…
[pic=2]Phew, ok, I’ve gotta get my head out of the clouds, I’ve got work to do!
target: [pic=2]Wuih, oke, aku harus berhenti melamun, ada pekerjaan!

source: [pic=2]The Beaver just told me about the Playbear you got him!
target: [pic=2]Si Berang-berang Pembuat Bendungan baru cerita tentang Playbear yang kamu bawakan!

source: [pic=3]That takes me way back! We used to drool over the hunks in these magazines for fun!
target: [pic=3]Mengingatkanku pada masa lalu! Dulu kami suka meneteskan ludah melihat para pria tampan di majalah ini!

source: [pic=1]Somethin’ tells me we won’t be seeing our beaver for a bit~
target: [pic=1]Rasanya kita tidak akan melihat si berang-berang pembuat bendungan untuk sementara~

source: [pic=1]Y’know way back in the day, he used to be seeing a great big grizzly!
target: [pic=1]Dulu sekali, dia pernah menjalin hubungan dengan grizzly yang besar!

source: [pic=3]Oooh, I heard you helped the mouse find her string!
target: [pic=3]Oooh, kudengar kamu membantu si tikus menemukan benangnya!

source: [pic=1]She told me all about her plans, and I am so excited to see her tie herself up!
target: [pic=1]Dia menceritakan semua rencananya, dan aku tidak sabar melihat dia mengikat tubuhnya sendiri!

source: [pic=3]… Oh actually… She’ll probably need some help, I’ll offer an extra pair of paws next time I see her.
target: [pic=3]… Oh, sebenarnya… Mungkin dia butuh bantuan, nanti kalau bertemu akan kutawarkan sepasang tangan tambahan.

source: [pic=2]She’s gonna be just the cutest lil’ wrapped up thing~!
target: [pic=2]Dia akan jadi si kecil terikat yang paling imut~!

source: [pic=1]… On second thought, maybe I’ll give those rods another go…
target: [pic=1]… Dipikir-pikir lagi, mungkin akan kucoba batang-batang itu sekali lagi…

source: [pic=3]How’d our otter do?
[pic=3]Sounding huh? That’s what he ended up liking?
target: [pic=3]Permainan uretra, ya? Jadi itu yang akhirnya dia suka?

source: [pic=1]Well heck, I’ve got some spare rods, can’t say I was ever a fan of that…
target: [pic=1]Yah, aku punya beberapa batang cadangan, tidak bisa dibilang aku pernah suka itu…

source: [pic=3]Different strokes I suppose!
Something is carved in the tree here…
target: Ada sesuatu diukir pada pohon di sini…

source: It’s difficult to read though…
